courses.title: Hydraulics
courses.description: Diagnosis of hydraulic and hydrostatic system operation and related pump and control systems; tasks performed on test simulators with focus on safe repair practices.

courses.title: Steering and Suspension Systems
courses.description: Diagnosis and service of wheels, tires, hubs, steering linkage, gear boxes, steering column, power steering pumps, rear suspension systems, and alignment.

courses.title: Drivetrain
courses.description: Overview and diagnostics for clutch systems, driveline, drive axle, manual and automated transmissions, PTO, 4x4 configurations, and transfer cases.

courses.title: Brakes
courses.description: Brake theory, air supply systems, diagnostic tools, hydraulic brakes, ABS, traction control, power assist units, and high-pressure brake diagnostics.

courses.title: Diesel Engines
courses.description: Engine fundamentals, cylinder head service, piston and liner assembly, and diagnostics for lubrication, cooling, air induction/exhaust, turbochargers, EGR, and aftertreatment.

courses.title: Diesel Engine Fuel Systems and Accessories
courses.description: Diesel fuel systems and diagnostics including low/high pressure common rail, HEUI, electronic management, and engine retarder systems.

courses.title: Preventative Maintenance
courses.description: DOT inspections, FMCSA guidelines, manufacturer specifications, and maintenance documentation for full-vehicle inspection.

courses.title: Transport Refrigeration
courses.description: Refrigeration theory, EPA 608 requirements, diagnostic procedures, brazing, and servicing of auxiliary power units.
